statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); display_dir="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"; out="$display_dir"; if [[ -f "$cwd/package.json" ]] || command -v node &>/dev/null && [[ -f "$cwd/.nvmrc" || -f "$cwd/.node-version" ]]; then node_ver=$(node --version 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$node_ver" ]] && out="$out via  $node_ver"; fi; gcloud_account=$(gcloud config get-value account 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$gcloud_account" && "$gcloud_account" != "(unset)" ]] && out="$out on  $gcloud_account"; if git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$out on  $branch"; fi; printf "%s" "$out"
